prompt:
The section sections/image-banner.liquid currently always renders its call-to-action link, even when the merchant left the button label or link empty, which produces broken empty buttons. Change it so the button only appears when it is fully configured. Inputs (all under section.settings, all strings that may be null): - section.settings.heading - section.settings.button_label - section.settings.button_link Required output: - Keep the outer element exactly as `
...
`. - Keep the heading behavior unchanged: when section.settings.heading is not null, output `

HEADING

`, where HEADING is the heading HTML-escaped with the core `escape` filter. When it is null, output no h2. - Strip leading and trailing whitespace from button_label and button_link. Treat null as an empty string. - Output the button `LABEL` after the heading only when BOTH the stripped label and the stripped link are non-empty. LINK and LABEL are the stripped values, HTML-escaped with `escape`. - Otherwise output no `a` element at all. - Emit no whitespace between elements, as the current file already does. - Keep the {% schema %} block byte-for-byte unchanged. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/image-banner.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
